findings.finding: The branch exports fixed Mainnet bank, token and Public Good addresses, but its own configuration marks budget, beneficiary, deployed ABI and runtime codehash authority unbound. Current Canon independently keeps company treasury unbound, payment disabled, settlement false and chain_write false.
findings.impact: An address-shaped proposal can be mistaken for an approved beneficiary, funded obligation or treasury instruction even though no such authority exists.
findings.disposition: HOLD; preserve NON_AUTHORITATIVE_PAYMENT_DRAFT only and require immutable action-specific Human authority, approved budget/cap and canonical beneficiary evidence before any executable successor.

findings.finding: readKaios18888PaymentReadiness accepts caller-supplied provider and bankReader objects. A reproduced fake reader reported a fabricated block 999999999, arbitrary sufficient balance, non-empty code, healthy bank and both roles, causing all ten observational gates to pass; only the four hard-coded authority gates kept the result FAIL_CLOSED.
findings.impact: The returned chain, code, balance, health, role and replay observations are not independently authenticated and must never be promoted to deployment, funding or authorization evidence.
findings.disposition: HOLD; bind trusted RPC, chain, finalized block, proxy, implementation, ABI, runtime codehash and role reads without caller-injected adapters.

findings.finding: The reader accepts any object with status NON_AUTHORITATIVE_PAYMENT_DRAFT and the configured beneficiary. It does not verify that the draft was produced by the validator or bind its chain, bank, request, amount, budget, nonce, purpose, time or hash fields to immutable source evidence.
findings.impact: A caller can forge the prepared object and shape the subsequent snapshot, even though the current final authority gates still fail closed.
findings.disposition: HOLD; use a versioned, fully hashed and provenance-verified draft envelope if the read-only observer is rebuilt.

findings.finding: observedTimestamp is optional. Omitting it skips future, stale and expiry checks and prepareKaios18888UnsignedDisbursement emits executable_at as NaN, which serializes to null. The reproduced request used 2099 timestamps and still produced a draft.
findings.impact: Invalid or timeless drafts can enter logs or downstream systems with a misleading payment-shaped identity.
findings.disposition: HOLD; require a verified chain timestamp and enforce requested_at, valid_until, observation and delay ordering with finite integer checks.

findings.finding: Request ID, budget ID and nonce are syntax-checked but never durably registered, reserved or consumed. replay_free checks only whether an existing tuple beneficiary is zero and does not verify the full disbursement record, cancellation state, concurrent reservation or exactly-once receipt lineage.
findings.impact: Repeated or concurrent drafts can reuse the same budget and nonce, oversubscribe an apparent available balance and diverge from any later execution path.
findings.disposition: HOLD; require durable transactional replay keys, budget reservation, idempotency and receipt reconciliation.

findings.finding: The disbursement ID binds request ID, bank, beneficiary, amount, budget and nonce but not chain ID, purpose, requester, request timestamps or requested delay. purpose_hash is separate and no signed or canonical envelope binds all semantics together.
findings.impact: Semantically different drafts can share the same disbursement identity or be recombined incorrectly by a later adapter.
findings.disposition: HOLD; define one domain-separated typed hash covering every authoritative field, version, chain and expiry before execution integration.

findings.finding: Current main records the 18888 proxy as deployed, but the branch checks only fixed addresses and non-empty bytecode. It does not verify EIP-1967 implementation, runtime codehash, ABI compatibility, upgrade history, governance state, paused state provenance or the canonical role holders at a finalized block.
findings.impact: A live address does not prove that the branch ABI or assumed payment semantics match the currently deployed and governed contract.
findings.disposition: HOLD; resolve exact deployed-source and proxy lineage from current-main manifests plus fresh independent reads.

findings.finding: The branch is 762 commits behind current main and both changed paths are three-way divergent. Its 241-test boundary predates the current 258-test Universal suite and later company, Canon and payment safety work.
findings.impact: Merging or mechanically rebasing the old files can discard later fail-closed behavior and create competing payment truth.
findings.disposition: Do not merge the original PR; any successor must be a minimal current-main implementation on a non-codex branch.

findings.finding: Both exact-head GitHub workflow runs and the reproduced local suite pass 241/241, but tests rely on local fixtures and do not cover missing observedTimestamp, forged prepared objects, trusted RPC provenance, proxy implementation identity, durable replay, concurrent budget reservation or actual authority evidence.
findings.impact: Green historical CI proves the intended fail-closed fixture behavior, not production payment readiness.
findings.disposition: Retain the runs as historical evidence only.
